title: Semantic Reranking at Inference Time for Hard Examples in Rhetorical Role Labeling
abstract: arXiv:2605.18007v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Rhetorical Role Labeling (RRL) assigns a functional role to each sentence in a document and is widely used in legal, medical, and scientific domains. While language models (LMs) achieve strong average performance, they remain unreliable on hard examples, where prediction confidence is low. Existing approaches typically handle uncertainty implicitly and treat labels as discrete identifiers, overlooking the semantic information encoded in label names. We introduce RISE, an inference-time semantic reranking framework that leverages label semantics to refine predictions on hard instances. RISE automatically identifies low-confidence predictions and reranks model outputs using contrastively learned label representations, without retraining or modifying the underlying model. Experiments on eight domain-specific RRL datasets with seven LMs, including encoder-based and causal architectures, show an average gain of +9.15 macro-F1 points on ha

translated_title: 面向修辞角色标注中难例的推理时语义重排序
translated_abstract: 修辞角色标注为文档中的每个句子分配功能角色，广泛应用于法律、医疗和科学领域。虽然语言模型在平均性能上表现强劲，但在预测置信度较低的难例上仍不可靠。现有方法通常隐式地处理不确定性，并将标签视为离散标识符，忽略了标签名称中蕴含的语义信息。我们提出了RISE，这是一种推理时语义重排序框架，利用标签语义来改进对难例的预测。RISE自动识别低置信度预测，并使用对比学习得到的标签表示对模型输出进行重排序，无需重新训练或修改底层模型。在八个特定领域的RRL数据集上使用七个语言模型（包括基于编码器和因果架构的模型）进行的实验表明，在难例上平均提升了9.15个macro-F1点。
tldr: 提出RISE推理时语义重排序框架，利用对比学习得到的标签表示自动识别并重排序低置信度难例的预测，在八个修辞角色标注数据集上平均提升9.15个macro-F1点，且无需重新训练模型。
en_tdlr: RISE is an inference-time semantic reranking framework that automatically identifies low-confidence hard examples and reranks predictions using contrastively learned label representations, achieving an average gain of +9.15 macro-F1 points on eight RRL datasets without retraining.
